question: Show earnings of retailers for July 2026
sql: SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, u.name AS retailer_name, SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earnings FROM users u JOIN wallet_transaction wt ON u.id = wt.user_id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND wt.reference_type IN ('topup', 'cash_point', 'referral_earning', 'coupon_redeem') AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_earnings DESC;

question: Show total earnings for July 2026
sql: SELECT SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earnings FROM wallet_transaction wt WHERE wt.reference_type IN ('topup', 'cash_point', 'referral_earning', 'coupon_redeem') AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00';

question: Show the retailer scanning report for July 2026
sql: SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, u.name AS retailer_name, SUM(qpm.box_calulation_um) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories si JOIN qr_point_map qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u ON si.status_retailer_id = u.id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC;

question: Show top 3 distributors by retailer box scans this month
sql: SELECT u.id AS distributor_id, u.name AS distributor_name, SUM(qpm.box_calulation_um) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories si JOIN qr_point_map qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u ON si.distributer_id = u.id WHERE u.user_role = 4 AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which state has the highest number of boxes scanned
sql: SELECT s.sname AS state_name, SUM(qpm.box_calulation_um) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories si JOIN qr_point_map qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u ON si.status_retailer_id = u.id JOIN state s ON u.state_id = s.id WHERE u.user_role = 2 GROUP BY s.sname ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which retailer under which distributor scanned the highest number of boxes
sql: SELECT u_ret.id AS retailer_id, u_ret.name AS retailer_name, u_dist.id AS distributor_id, u_dist.name AS distributor_name, SUM(qpm.box_calulation_um) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories si JOIN qr_point_map qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u_ret ON si.status_retailer_id = u_ret.id JOIN users u_dist ON si.distributer_id = u_dist.id WHERE u_ret.user_role = 2 AND u_dist.user_role = 4 GROUP BY u_ret.id, u_ret.name, u_dist.id, u_dist.name ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1;
